scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n PORTAL,M1-API,M1-WEB,M2-API,M2-WEB -c yellow,blue,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:m1-api" "npm run dev:m1-web" "npm run dev:m2-api" "npm run dev:m2-web"
scripts.dev:m1-api: dotenv -e module-1-voice-interview/.env.local -- python -m uvicorn api.index:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir module-1-voice-interview
scripts.dev:m2-api: dotenv -e module-2-sentiment-chatbot/.env.local -- python -m uvicorn api.index:app --reload --port 8001 --app-dir module-2-sentiment-chatbot
scripts.build: npm run build -w module-1-voice-interview && npm run build -w module-2-sentiment-chatbot
